name: lim
reference: Less is More: Structural community selection for deep graph clustering (Less-is-More).

upstream.note: The Encoder/Summarizer/corruption/cluster_net (model.py) and DeepGraphInfomax (DGI.py) are imported unchanged; the patch is a single device-correctness fix in DGI.forward (community index tensors on the embedding's device) so the model runs on GPU. main.py is left pristine and unused; training and the structural-community selection are reproduced in run_lim.py on the shared harness.
upstream.variant: O(n^2): dense modularity matrix and dense adjacency; will MLE on large graphs. Takes no target k -- Louvain selects the large structural communities as anchors and their count is K.

hidden.doc: Hidden dimensionality of the DGI encoder. Settable per graph class but excluded from tuning.

feature_kind.doc: Synthetic node representation used only when the instance has no real features.

clustertemp.doc: Softmax temperature for the cluster assignments.

resolution.doc: Louvain resolution for structural-community selection; the granularity knob (higher yields more, smaller communities). LIM takes no target k.

sparse_modularity.doc: Protocol B: compute the modularity term from the sparse adjacency instead of the authors' dense n x n matrix (numerically equivalent, but O(n) memory). Off keeps Protocol A faithful to the reference code.
